test_item_verbatim: IF ( (STATUS_CCAN3.VehicleSpeedVSOSig>(greater) MAX_SPEED AND LTM_OperationalModeSts.Info ="Ignition_On_EngOn" ) OR (after T_DISPLAY time STATUS_CCAN4.ReverseGearSts==(equal) "Not_Inserted" ) THEN

tcs.tc_title: 2261 off-point, read the HU display within the delay period and check that the rear view camera image is still displayed
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. The camera delay setting is set to "On"
4. The rear view camera image is displayed in Automatic Display Mode
5. The calibration MAX_SPEED corresponds to 8 mph per CFTS092 4781643
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN4.ReverseGearSts = 0 (Not_Inserted)
2. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN3.VehicleSpeedVSOSig = 205 (12.8125 km/h)
3. Read the HU display within the delay period and check that the rear view camera image is still displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_CCAN4.ReverseGearSts = 0 (Not_Inserted) is sent and the rear view camera image stays displayed
2. STATUS_CCAN3.VehicleSpeedVSOSig = 205 (12.8125 km/h) is sent
3. The rear view camera image is still displayed within the delay period
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.test_item:
IF ( (STATUS_CCAN3.VehicleSpeedVSOSig>(greater) MAX_SPEED AND LTM_OperationalModeSts.Info ="Ignition_On_EngOn" ) OR (after T_DISPLAY time STATUS_CCAN4.ReverseGearSts==(equal) "Not_Inserted" ) THEN

(2261 off-point, read the HU display within the delay period and check that the rear view camera image is still displayed)

reasoning: 驗證目標為 VF551_V33（Toro 2261）之速度門檻未達側：raw 205 = 12.8125 km/h = 7.9614 mph，低於 MAX_SPEED，影像於延遲期內續顯。與 NR1L-RVC-030 成 on／off 一對（§8.3 每點一 TC）。V33 之另一支退出條件（after T_DISPLAY time ReverseGearSts = Not_Inserted）即 Delay 到期，由 NR1L-RVC-007／-008 承接（§8.2.1）。
